pb-tender.title: Tender response
pb-tender.intro: Answer from client evidence. You write prices and submit the bid yourself.
pb-tender.uploadHelp: Text, CSV, XLSX, or a readable PDF on desktop. Files stay with this order.
pb-tender.pasted: Use RFP text from the order
pb-tender.bucketHelp: Choose separate evidence files. The RFP cannot prove its own requirements.
pb-tender.mappingHelp: Import the issuer workbook questions. Only mapped answer cells change; protected cells need manual filling.
pb-tender.replaceCheck: Replace all saved questions and answers from these sources.
pb-tender.private: Private documents stay manual until a qualified local model is available.
pb-tender.aiHelp: AI sees only the exact request you approve. Review its draft against the client evidence.
pb-tender.loadError: The current work could not be loaded. Reopen this order before approving.
pb-tender.stale: The client or source changed. Review and replace the questions before continuing.
pb-tender.dirty: Save your edited answers and controls before approval or AI requests.
pb-tender.reassignHelp: Changing type clears its answer. Commercial questions remain owner-only.
pb-tender.ownerOnly: Write this commercial answer yourself. Every amount must match your client quote.
pb-tender.supported: The saved answer matches the supplied evidence.
pb-tender.gap: Source gaps or unsupported claims need your review.
pb-tender.previewHelp: Review these exact client documents and instructions before the AI call.
pb-tender.exportHelp: Prepare the approved Word, Excel and CSV files. Issuer workbooks keep their other cells. You submit them yourself.
pb-tender.downloadHelp: Files are ready to download. A download does not confirm that your device saved them.
pb-tender.receiptHelp: Code copied this exact currency amount from the client quote. This is not a price recommendation.
pb-tender.error.REQUEST_FAILED: This action could not finish. Reload the current work and try again.
pb-tender.error.INVALID_VENTURE_REQUEST: Check the selected fields and try again.
pb-tender.error.TENDER_SOURCE_REQUIRED: Choose readable client evidence separately from the RFP.
pb-tender.error.TENDER_COLUMN_MAP_REQUIR: Choose the sheet, distinct columns and valid question rows.
pb-tender.error.APPROVAL_CHANGED: The saved work changed. Review its current version again.
pb-tender.error.DERIVED_STALE: Source files or the client changed. Import the current questions again.
pb-tender.error.TENDER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: Approve every exact answer by type before preparing files.
pb-tender.error.TENDER_GROUNDING_REQUIRE: Resolve missing source evidence and unsupported claims first.
pb-tender.error.PRICING_OWNER_ONLY: Only you may write commercial and pricing answers.
pb-tender.error.PRIVATE_NEEDS_LOCAL: Private sources need a qualified local model. Write manually meanwhile.
pb-tender.error.NO_MODEL_CONNECTED: Connect an AI in Your AI before asking for a draft.
pb-tender.error.TENDER_LENGTH_EXCEEDED: Shorten the answer to the chosen word limit.
pb-tender.error.TENDER_ANSWER_REQUIRED: Write every answer in this question type first.
pb-tender.error.TENDER_WORKBOOK_PROTECTE: A target cell is protected, merged or a formula. Choose another column or fill it manually.
pb-tender.error.TENDER_EXPORT_INVALID: This workbook cannot be filled safely. Review the mapping or fill it manually.
pb-tender.error.OOXML_UNREADABLE: Save the file again from Word or Excel and add it once more.
pb-tender.error.TIER_UNAVAILABLE: Read this PDF on desktop, or add a text or spreadsheet export.
pb-tender.error.TOOL_FAILED: The desktop PDF reader is unavailable. Add readable text or a spreadsheet meanwhile.
pb-tender.error.TENDER_INPUT_INVALID: Check the question, answer, type and word limit.
